items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: Interviewee states 'My name is Willie Madison'.

ctx.x: Get everybody to say something to give their names. Let's see. This is an interview being recorded. 1619 North Galveston. That's it, huh? Yeah. And it's in the back in Billy and the D's little house here. Yeah. And this is Dick Allen talking now. Billy, give me your name so we'll know what your voice sounds like.
My name is Willie Madison. Goodson Pierce.
Mm-hmm. And the D? Joseph Rockwell Pierce. But everybody called you the D, huh? Oh, the D, yeah.
